title: Durchsuchungsbeschlüsse wegen des Verdachts des bandenmäßigen Drogenhandels vollstreckt – vierzehn Festnahmen

extraction.summaryEn: Police and prosecutors executed 28 search warrants in Berlin and Brandenburg against 20 suspects accused of commercial drug trafficking. Fourteen suspects were arrested, and drugs, cash, knives and a blank-firing gun were seized.
